name: Rolex Vintage 1950s Store Display Sign | Brass
description:
An exceedingly rare and well preserved ROLEX brass and glass signage from the 1950s.

The history of this sign is that it was salvaged during renovations by a store employee of the Interlaken Bucherer Rolex retailer  (a mountain resort in Switzerland).

The letters are made of brass and they are in the typical font we find on the 50s/60s Rolex. The lettering is quite chunky and three dimensional set on a glass panel. In good conditions with some expected surface patina.
